analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Below SMA100 (112,955 KRW), above SMA200 (91,229 KRW): medium-to-long term trend favors weakness.
· 52-week position (60.6%) + current price level entering historical middle ground.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.0→51.9) + neutral zone sustained: lack of directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1780.3749→1387.9737) + convergence continuing: no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (mid-band 103,670 KRW) + band width slowing expansion at 21.51%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (82,710 KRW): Pivot (103,543 KRW) and SMA20 (103,670 KRW) acting as short-term support.
· Swing resistance (114,710 KRW): breaking this level suggests potential uptrend reversal.
· 5-day high (110,910 KRW) / low (101,105 KRW), 20-day high (114,710 KRW) / low (86,785 KRW): confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.76x): declining confidence in recent price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): consider buying on confirmation of breaking the 114,710 KRW resistance.
